name: Stripe
notes: The repo README marks /latest/ as recommended (v1 + v2 endpoints). The legacy v1-only /openapi/spec3.{json,yaml} is still updated and served from the same Official repo; accepted as a correct Spec Source by Wes 2026-09-22, since code cannot infer the README's recommendation from APIs.guru's link.

name: GitHub REST API
notes: The repo also holds descriptions for GitHub Enterprise Cloud (ghec) and Server (ghes-*); only api.github.com is listed.

name: Twilio Verify
notes: Bare "Twilio" names many APIs, so it is an ambiguous entry; this one names the Verify API (v2).

name: Slack Web API
notes: Swagger 2.0, Slack Web API 1.7.0, 170 paths, served by Slack at api.slack.com. The older GitHub copy (slackapi/slack-api-specs, web-api/slack_web_openapi_v2.json, 1.7.0, 174 paths) is in a repo archived since 2021-09-07, so it is not the Current Spec. Relabelled to api.slack.com by Wes, 2026-09-22.

name: Jira Cloud Platform REST API
notes: REST v3 is taken as the Current Spec; REST v2 is still live and would be an Alternate.

name: DigitalOcean API
notes: The Spaces URL is the bundled single-file spec linked from the repo README; the GitHub raw file is the multi-file root with $refs.

name: PagerDuty REST API
notes: The evidence page is the repo README ("our OpenAPI defined public APIs"); it does not name the file path, which comes from the repo tree.

name: Plaid
notes: 2020-09-14 is Plaid's only current API Version and the only spec in the repo.

name: Cloudflare API
notes: The sibling openapi.yaml (19 MB) failed to parse with PyYAML in this session, so only the JSON is listed. `developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json` is the same Cloudflare API v4.0.0 (same server, 2233 vs 2241 paths) from the Vendor's own docs host; accepted as a second Official Source by Wes 2026-09-22.

name: Fly.io Machines API
notes: fly.io links "OpenAPI spec" to the docs.machines.dev viewer, not to the JSON; /spec/openapi3.json redirects to /openapi.json.

name: Neon API
notes: neon.tech redirects to neon.com.

name: Supabase Management API
notes: `supabase.com/openapi.json` serves the same document as the api.supabase.com URL (Supabase API (v1), 115 paths) from the Vendor's own domain; accepted as a second Official Source by Wes 2026-09-22.

name: Loops
notes: app.loops.so/openapi.yaml is the same document as openapi.json (Loops API 1.21.14, 43 paths, server app.loops.so/api; identical once parsed, checked 2026-09-22); accepted as a Spec Source by Wes 2026-09-22, as Novu's openapi.yaml was.

name: Replicate
notes: info.version is 1.0.0-a1; Replicate does not label the HTTP API as preview.

name: Codeberg API
notes: Swagger 2.0, titled "Forgejo API": Codeberg runs Forgejo, and every Forgejo/Gitea instance serves a similar spec. The API here is Codeberg's hosted instance. Expected NoSpec, not Resolved: `codeberg.org/robots.txt` disallows `/swagger.*.json` by name and also `/api/`, which is the page that links it, so ADR 0003's Vendor-linked exception does not reach it. The Spec exists and is listed above for the day that changes.

name: Infisical
notes: The docs page names the spec URL only in its embedded API-reference config, not as a visible link. `infisical.com/openapi.json` serves the same document (same version, 1510 paths) from the Vendor's own domain; accepted as a second Official Source by Wes 2026-09-22.

name: Render API
notes: Named "Render API" because bare "Render" is a common word.

name: Firecrawl
notes: v2 is taken as the Current Spec; the docs page names it only in its embedded API-reference config. https://docs.firecrawl.dev/api-reference/v1-openapi.json is still served and would be an Alternate.

name: Mux
notes: One spec covers Mux Video and Mux Data. `www.mux.com/full-combined-spec.json` is a strict superset (all 115 paths plus 9 playback/image paths on image.mux.com) from the Vendor's own domain; accepted as a correct Spec Source by Wes 2026-09-22.

name: Val Town
notes: The evidence page is Val Town's API-reference viewer, which links this spec URL. `api.val.town/robots.txt` disallows `/`, so this entry can only be Resolved through ADR 0003's Vendor-linked exception: `docs.val.town` allows crawling and its `/openapi` page carries the link.

name: Google
notes: Google has hundreds of APIs; the candidates are three from the evidence page, not a full list.

name: Azure
notes: Azure has hundreds of Resource Manager APIs; the candidates are four from the evidence page, not a full list.

name: Twilio
notes: The issue lists Twilio as a popular example; it is labelled Ambiguous because Twilio publishes one spec per API (Api v2010, Verify, Conversations, ...). twilio.com/api is the core api.twilio.com 2010-04-01 API. A reviewer may prefer Resolved to twilio.com/api.

name: Cisco
notes: Meraki's API is hosted on meraki.com; cisco.com is used as the Vendor domain here.

name: Reddit API
notes: The API docs page offers no OpenAPI or Swagger file, and a GitHub search of the reddit org for "openapi" found nothing.

name: Dropbox API
notes: Dropbox describes its API in its own Stone format (github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec), not OpenAPI. Community OpenAPI conversions exist and must not count.

name: Steam Web API
notes: Valve's docs offer no OpenAPI or Swagger file; community specs exist and must not count.
